listing.name: Crash Team Racing / CTR Native Android (Simon358)
listing.summary: Explore Crash Team Racing / CTR Native Android (Simon358) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Install this fork’s Android APK and open its Missing Assets screen. Follow its storage-permission handoff, choose Select File, and select your own Crash Team Racing NTSC-U raw BIN or supported BIGFILE.BIG. The app copies the chosen data to its own assets storage; restart the app after the copy. Do not use another region or the parent’s desktop executable as an Android package. The source targets a 32-bit Android memory model and requires OpenGL ES 3.0.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Keep your original disc data and preserve the app’s saves/data before Android app replacement or removal. The Android guide describes /data/data/com.ctrnative/files/assets for picker copies and a different external assets path for manual PC/root setup; use the picker instead of guessing between them. Release Build4 adds touch controls when no controller is detected. Full-game and device coverage remain unqualified; Portcove owns neither APK updates nor its profile backup.
